title: Tror, tycker or tänker? Swedish verbs explained with quiz | SvenskaVardag
text:
"I think..." has three different verbs in Swedish: tror, tycker and tänker. Which one do you use, and when?

🎬 In this lesson:
• tror = I think it's likely (a guess)
• tycker = I think / my opinion (and tycker om = I like)
• tänker = I'm planning to, or tänker på = I'm thinking about
• A 4-question quiz to test yourself

📝 Example: "Jag tror att det kommer att regna." = I think it's going to rain.

✍️ Write a sentence about your weekend in the comments!
